name: walk-pr
description: Stage-by-stage guided PR tour with a one-click side pane: problem and approach diagrams, concept stages, findings you decide on, one review posted at the end. The same pane plans and implements a change: decisions with options, commit-by-commit run, draft PR

paneBackground.title: Pane background
paneBackground.description: Colour painted behind the pane in a terminal: a hex like #253439, or a theme key that follows your theme (subtle, inactive, promptBorder). Empty keeps the terminal's own pane colour.
